QUOTE: Patterns are strings of the form `server.tool` or `server.tool:argpattern`, matched with `fnmatch` (no `FNM_PATHNAME`, so `*` also crosses `/` and `:`). `pattern_matches` splits at the first `:`: - **No colon** (e.g. `filesystem.*`, `git.commit`): only the tool name is matched, so every call to that tool matches regardless of arguments.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states fnmatch matching, the split at the first colon into tool and argument parts, and that a no-colon pattern matches on the tool name alone.
